name: Chelsea Commons
summary: Chelsea Commons is a community shopping center located on Revere Beach Parkway in Chelsea, Massachusetts, operated by Federal Realty Investment Trust. Serving the Greater Boston area with convenient access and everyday retail options, the center maintains strong community connections with a 4.2-star rating from over 1,500 reviews.
demographics: Chelsea Commons attracts a diverse, working-class to middle-income demographic from the Greater Boston area, particularly serving the densely populated communities of Chelsea, Revere, and East Boston. The trade area includes a significant Hispanic population along with multi-generational families seeking convenient access to everyday shopping needs. Visitors typically prioritize value-oriented retailers and essential services, with strong foot traffic from nearby residential neighborhoods and commuters along the Revere Beach Parkway corridor.
description: Chelsea Commons is a community shopping center strategically located at 1100 Revere Beach Parkway in Chelsea, Massachusetts, serving the Greater Boston metropolitan area. Owned and operated by Federal Realty Investment Trust, a leading real estate investment trust with a portfolio of high-quality retail properties across the United States, this center provides convenient access to everyday shopping and services for the surrounding communities. The center's location along the busy Revere Beach Parkway makes it easily accessible to residents of Chelsea, Revere, East Boston, and neighboring areas. With operating hours from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily, Chelsea Commons offers flexibility for shoppers throughout the week. The center has earned a solid 4.2-star rating from over 1,500 Google reviews, reflecting its role as a reliable neighborhood shopping destination that meets the daily needs of the local community.
